units.locator: Article 66. Development of civil service
units.text: 2. The civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be developed in accordance with its principal development directions determined by regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities and (or) their state programmes, taking into account the principal directions for development of federal civil service determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 66

units.locator: Article 66. Development of civil service
units.text: 3. Experiments applying new approaches to organizing civil service and supporting civil servants' activities may be conducted in a state body, its autonomous structural subdivision or territorial body, or in several state bodies (hereinafter an experiment).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 66

units.locator: Article 66. Development of civil service
units.text: 4. For the duration of an experiment, but for no more than one year, the terms of the service contracts of participating civil servants may be changed. Such changes shall be made under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation and must not reduce a participating civil servant's monetary remuneration below the amount payable at the start of the experiment or demote the civil servant relative to the position held at that time.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 66

units.locator: Article 66. Development of civil service
units.text: 5. The procedure for organizing and requirements for conducting experiments aimed at developing federal civil service shall be established by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 66

units.locator: Article 66. Development of civil service
units.text: 6. The procedure for organizing and requirements for conducting experiments aimed at developing the civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be established by regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 66

units.locator: Chapter 15. STATE SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OVER COMPLIANCE WITH THE LEGISLATION OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION ON THE STATE CIVIL SERVICE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
units.text: Chapter 15. STATE SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OVER COMPLIANCE WITH THE LEGISLATION OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION ON THE STATE CIVIL SERVICE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
units.label: Chapter 15. STATE SUPERVISION AND CONTROL OVER COMPLIANCE WITH THE LEGISLATION OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION ON THE STATE CIVIL SERVICE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION

units.locator: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. State supervision and extra-departmental control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation shall be exercised by specially authorized state bodies designated by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. Federal state bodies and state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall exercise intra-departmental control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation in subordinate state bodies.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Bodies for state supervision and control over compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation and subordinate prosecutors shall exercise state supervision over precise and uniform compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation, in accordance with federal law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 67

units.locator: Article 68. Liability for breach of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 68. Liability for breach of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 68

units.locator: Article 68. Liability for breach of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation
units.text: Persons responsible for breaching the legislation of the Russian Federation on the state civil service of the Russian Federation shall be held liable under the procedure established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Art. 68 · text

units.locator: Chapter 16. CONSIDERATION OF INDIVIDUAL SERVICE DISPUTES
units.text: Chapter 16. CONSIDERATION OF INDIVIDUAL SERVICE DISPUTES
units.label: Chapter 16. CONSIDERATION OF INDIVIDUAL SERVICE DISPUTES

units.locator: Article 69. Individual service dispute
units.text: Article 69. Individual service dispute
units.label: Art. 69

units.locator: Article 69. Individual service dispute
units.text: An individual service dispute means unresolved disagreements between the employer's representative and a civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, concerning the application of laws, other regulatory legal acts on civil service or the service contract, which have been submitted to a body for consideration of individual service disputes.
units.label: Art. 69 · text

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.label: Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 1. Individual service disputes (hereinafter service disputes) shall be considered by the following bodies for consideration of individual service disputes (hereinafter service dispute bodies):
units.label: Part 1 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 1) the state body's service disputes commission;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 2) a court.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 2. The procedure for considering service disputes in service dispute bodies shall be governed by this Federal Law and other federal laws; the procedure for hearing service dispute cases in courts shall also be determined by the civil procedural legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 3. The state body's service disputes commission (hereinafter the service disputes commission) shall be established by decision of the employer's representative and consist of equal numbers of representatives appointed by the employer's representative and representatives of civil servants elected at a meeting (conference) of the state body's civil servants, including a representative (representatives) of the elected trade union body (bodies) of that state body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 4. A meeting (conference) of the state body's civil servants shall be held by decision of the employer's representative, including in response to a request from civil servants or the state body's elected trade union body.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 4.1. A meeting of the state body's civil servants shall have a quorum if more than half of the state body's civil servants are present.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 4.2. A conference of the state body's civil servants shall have a quorum if at least two thirds of the civil servants elected as delegates from the state body's subdivisions at their respective meetings, including in its territorial bodies, are present.
units.label: Part 4.2 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 4.3. A decision of the state body's civil servants' meeting (conference) shall be adopted by a majority of the votes of the civil servants (delegates) present.
units.label: Part 4.3 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 4.4. The employer's representative shall create the necessary organizational conditions for holding the state body's civil servants' meeting (conference).
units.label: Part 4.4 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 5. The service disputes commission shall have its own seal. Organizational and technical support for its activities shall be provided by the state body.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 6. The service disputes commission shall elect a chairperson and secretary from among its members.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 7. A service dispute shall be considered by the service disputes commission if the civil servant, acting independently or with a representative, has not resolved the disagreements through direct negotiations with the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 8. A civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, may apply to the service disputes commission within three months from the day on which they learned or should have learned that their right had been violated.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 9. If the time limit established by part 8 of this Article has been missed for valid reasons, the service disputes commission may restore it and consider the merits of the dispute. A written application received by the commission from a civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, must be registered by the commission on the day it is submitted.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 10. The service disputes commission must consider a service dispute within ten calendar days from submission of the written application by a civil servant, or a citizen entering or formerly in civil service.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 11. A meeting of the service disputes commission shall have a quorum if at least half of its members representing the employer's representative and at least half of its members representing civil servants are present. If one or more representatives of the state body's elected trade union body (bodies) have been elected to the commission, the commission may not meet without their participation.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 11.1. If a conflict of interest arises or may arise during consideration of a service dispute, a commission member with a direct or indirect personal interest in the decision must declare it before the commission meeting begins or during consideration of the dispute. That member shall then take no further part in considering or deciding the dispute.
units.label: Part 11.1 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 11.2. A member of the service disputes commission who is directly subordinate to or under the control of the civil servant concerned in the dispute, or who is closely related to that civil servant by blood or marriage (parents, spouses, children, brothers, sisters, and the spouse's brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children's spouses), shall not participate in the commission meeting or in deciding that service dispute.
units.label: Part 11.2 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 11.3. A service dispute shall be considered in the presence of the civil servant, or citizen entering or formerly in civil service, who submitted a written application to the service disputes commission, or a representative authorized by that civil servant or citizen (hereinafter in this Article an authorized representative). Consideration in the absence of that civil servant or citizen or the authorized representative shall be permitted only upon the civil servant's or citizen's written request.
units.label: Part 11.3 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 11.4. If the civil servant, citizen entering or formerly in civil service, or authorized representative fails to attend the service disputes commission meeting for a valid reason, consideration of the dispute shall be postponed. If the civil servant, citizen or authorized representative fails to attend a second time, the commission may decide to remove the dispute from consideration; this shall not deprive the civil servant or citizen of the right to apply for consideration again within the time limit established by part 8 of this Article.
units.label: Part 11.4 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 11.5. If the service disputes commission has not considered a service dispute within ten days, the civil servant, or citizen entering or formerly in civil service, may transfer consideration of the dispute to a court.
units.label: Part 11.5 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 11.6. The service disputes commission may summon witnesses to its meeting, invite specialists and request information and materials necessary to consider the service dispute, which shall be supplied to the commission within the time limit it sets.
units.label: Part 11.6 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 11.7. The service disputes commission shall decide by secret ballot by a simple majority of the votes of members present. A copy of the decision, signed by the commission's chairperson or deputy chairperson and certified with its seal, shall be delivered to the employer's representative and to the civil servant, citizen entering or formerly in civil service, or authorized representative within three days from the decision.
units.label: Part 11.7 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 12. Either party may appeal against the service disputes commission's decision to a court within ten days after receiving a copy. If this time limit has been missed for valid reasons, the court may restore it and consider the merits of the service dispute.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 13. Courts shall consider service disputes on written applications from a civil servant, a citizen entering or formerly in civil service, the employer's representative or a representative of the state body's elected trade union body, if at least one of them disagrees with the service disputes commission's decision or if the civil servant or employer's representative applies directly to the court without applying to the commission; courts shall also consider applications from a prosecutor if the commission's decision does not comply with federal laws or other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 14. Courts shall directly consider service disputes on written applications from:
units.label: Part 14 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 1) a civil servant or a citizen formerly in civil service, concerning reinstatement in the civil service position previously held, irrespective of the grounds for termination or cancellation of the service contract, release from the civil service position or dismissal from civil service; a change to the date of release from the position or wording of the reason for release; transfer to another civil service position without consent; pay for a period of enforced absence or payment of the difference in monetary remuneration for the period of performing duties in a lower-paid civil service position; or unlawful actions (inaction) of the employer's representative or persons authorized by them in processing and protecting the civil servant's personal data;
units.label: Point 1 Part 14 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 2) the employer's representative, concerning compensation by the civil servant for damage caused to the state body, unless otherwise provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Point 2 Part 14 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 15. Courts shall also directly consider service disputes:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 1) concerning unlawful refusal of entry into civil service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 2) on written applications from civil servants who consider that they have suffered discrimination.
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 16. Where release from a civil service position and dismissal from civil service are based on grounds not provided for by this Federal Law or breach the established procedure, or where transfer to another civil service position is unlawful, the court may, upon the civil servant's written application, order monetary compensation for the non-pecuniary harm caused to them. The amount shall be determined by the court.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Bodies for consideration of individual service disputes
units.text: 17. Time limits for applying to a court for consideration of a service dispute and the procedure for exempting civil servants from court costs; the procedure for deciding service disputes concerning release from a civil service position and dismissal from civil service or transfer to another civil service position without consent; the procedure for satisfying civil servants' monetary claims and enforcing decisions on reinstatement in a previously held civil service position; and restrictions on recovery of sums paid under decisions of service dispute bodies shall be determined under the procedure established by labour legislation for consideration and resolution of individual labour disputes.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 70

units.locator: Chapter 17. ENTRY INTO FORCE OF THIS FEDERAL LAW
units.text: Chapter 17. ENTRY INTO FORCE OF THIS FEDERAL LAW
units.label: Chapter 17. ENTRY INTO FORCE OF THIS FEDERAL LAW

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.label: Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 1. This Federal Law shall enter into force six months after the day of its official publication, except for Articles 50, 51 and 55 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 2. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 280-ФЗ of 25.12.2008.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 3. The provisions of Articles 50, 51 and 55 of this Federal Law shall enter into force for federal civil servants simultaneously with the entry into force of the Decree of the President of the Russian Federation on federal civil servants' monetary remuneration.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 4. The procedure for entry into force of Articles 50, 51 and 55 of this Federal Law for civil servants of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be determined by laws and other regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities, taking into account the provisions of this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 5. The conditions for payment of monetary remuneration or monetary emoluments to state servants recognized as civil servants under this Federal Law, as established on the date this Federal Law enters into force, including the amounts of monetary emoluments, position salaries and established supplements and the conditions and procedure for their payment, shall apply until regulatory legal acts establishing civil servants' monetary remuneration in accordance with this Federal Law enter into force.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 6. Until the relevant state service management body is established, its tasks and functions shall be performed by state bodies in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and the legislation of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 7. Monetary remuneration established for civil servants in accordance with this Federal Law may not be lower than the monetary remuneration established for state servants on the date this Federal Law enters into force.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 8. Qualification grades previously conferred on federal state servants shall be deemed to be the corresponding civil service class ranks provided for in Article 11 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 9. Periods of work (service) previously included (credited) under the established procedure in length of civil service shall count towards that length for granting monthly supplements to the position salary for length of civil service, additional annual paid leave for length of service and incentives for civil service in accordance with this Federal Law and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 10. The conditions of medical and sanatorium-resort services for state servants recognized as civil servants under this Federal Law and their family members, including after the state servants retire on a length-of-service pension, shall be retained until the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation enters into force.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 71

units.locator: Article 71. Entry into force of this Federal Law
units.text: 11. Length-of-service pension provision for federal state servants shall be retained until the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families enters into force.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 71
